title: David Adeney Et Al - Enquiry By U.S. Marshal Re

page_data.en:
T.T.Hsu
FORM NO. 8
G. 50-10

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 720/10
S.I., Special Branch
REPORT
Date July 5. 1941.
Subject (in full) David Adeney et al. Enquiry by U.S. Marshal re.
Made by. D.S.I. Cornwell. Forwarded by D.S.I. Wilcox.

In response to a letter from the U.S. Marshal
dated July 1st, 1941, asking for histories of David
Adeney, John Dunlop, Henry Heathcote and wife Ethel
and Evdoksia Drumheller, I have to report that there
is nothing in Police Records regarding these persons.

Wish.

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH）

A. C. (Special Branch)

H. S. Cornwell
D. S. I.

Sent
577.

FILE
page_data.zh:
T.T.徐
表格第8号
G. 50-10

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 720/10
S.I.，特别科
报告
日期：1941年7月5日。
事由（全称）：关于大卫·阿德尼（David Adeney）等人。美国联邦执法官就此事进行的查询。
呈报人：副督察长康威尔（D.S.I. Cornwell）。转呈人：副督察长威尔科克斯（D.S.I. Wilcox）。

兹回复1941年7月1日美国联邦执法官来函，该函要求提供大卫·阿德尼（David Adeney）、约翰·邓洛普（John Dunlop）、亨利·希思科特（Henry Heathcote）及其妻子埃塞尔（Ethel）以及叶夫多基娅·德拉姆赫勒（Evdoksia Drumheller）的个人履历。经查，警务处档案中并无上述人员之记录。

此致。

（印章：特别科）

A. C.（特别科）

H. S. 康威尔
副督察长

已发送
577.

归档

DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE
Office of
The United States Marshal
Shanghai.

Date July 1, 1941.

CONFIDENTIAL INQUIRY

To The Commissioner
Shanghai Municipal Police
Attention: Mr. R.F. Torum

Please provide us with routine report within three days concerning Police record, character comment, local reputation, etc. on the following persons:

| Name | Age | Nationality | Time in S'hai | Business, Occupation, or Local Address |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| David Meney | 29 | British | | China Inland Mission |
| John Dunlop | 40 | British | | 1569 Avenue Joffre |
| Henry Hethcote and wife Ethel | 46 | British | | 151 Jessfield Road |
| Evdoksia Drumbeller | 37 | Russian | | 17/33 Rte Paul Henry |

Charles Richardson, Jr.,
United States Marshal
